Chris's first folder video","contentUrl":"https://embed-ssl.wistia.com/deliveries/276a1c1dcb2c58df8efd8fb3884bb2995702d533.m3u8","transcript":"Building software at enterprise scale has never been simple. Your developers balance hundreds of repositories, thousands of issues, and are under constant pressure to ship faster. But it's not just about speed. It's about precision.\n\nEvery line of code must follow your standards, meet your compliance requirements, and pass reviews, and every leader knows the stakes. Just one missed security check, one licensing violation, one bad commit can ripple across the entire organization. AI coding assistants promise to change that. They promised productivity, shortcuts, fewer mistakes.\n\nBut most of them were built for individuals, not enterprises. They struggle with large existing code bases. They make clever suggestions, but they don't understand your architecture. They don't follow your rules.\n\nThey don't enforce your standards. They may even use code that can't legally be used in your products. They're fast, but they're risky. And in the enterprise, risk isn't an option.\n\nTAB nine takes a different path. We're the enterprise AI coding platform built from the ground up for secure standards aware development. With Tab nine, AI works across your entire development life cycle in three powerful ways. Completions keep your developers in flow, offering secure context aware suggestions trained only on permissively licensed code and your own repositories. It's the speed of autocomplete, but aligned with your standards.\n\nChat goes beyond generic answers. It connects directly to your code base, your issues, and your documentation. So every response is grounded in your organization's knowledge, not just the Internet's. And agents do the heavy lifting.\n\nThey don't just suggest code. They implement scoped features across multiple files and repos, fix issues end to end, review pull requests against your standards, and generate living documentation that stays in sync with the work, all of it happening inside your environment and always within guardrails you define. At the core of the platform is Tab nine's enterprise context engine. This is what makes Tab nine different.\n\nIt brings systemic awareness of your entire code base, architecture and dependencies, coding standards, and ensures that AI outputs are explainable, governed, and trustworthy. Tab nine plugs into your source code management system of choice, including GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Perforce, and more. So AI works directly against the repos where your code lives. We support over six hundred programming languages, frameworks, and libraries, ensuring Tab nine fits seamlessly into every part of your stack.\n\nYour developers don't need to change how they work. Tab nine integrates directly into the IDEs they already use, from Versus Code to JetBrains, Eclipse, and Visual Studio. Tab nine is model flexible. We integrate with leading LLMs, whether hosted on prem, via private endpoints, or connected to your preferred provider, giving you choice without lock in.\n\nEvery enterprise is different. Some run-in the cloud, some in private clouds, others on premises or in fully air gapped environments where not a single packet can leave the network. Tab nine is built to meet you wherever you are. The same secure coding platform, completions, chat, and agents deployed in the environments you choose.\n\nNo external dependencies. No hidden connections. Total control over performance, security, and cost. Our agents work with your code base, your standards, and your requirements.\n\nAnd every step is observable, auditable, and reversible.\n\nTabNine doesn't just generate code. TabNine ships code you can trust. That's why TabNine is trusted by over a million developers worldwide and why Gartner recognized TabNine as a visionary vendor in the AI code assistant market. In a world full of risky shortcuts, TabNine is the enterprise coding platform that helps your teams move faster without losing control. This is AI for how enterprises really build software.\n\nThis is TabNine.","potentialAction":{"@type":"SeekToAction","target":"https://www.tabnine.com/?wtime={seek_to_second_number}","startOffset-input":"required name=seek_to_second_number"}}</script>
